Are you a hands-on technical professional who enjoys taking ownership, solving practical challenges, and creating a safe, efficient, and well-organized working environment? Do you like working independently, improving processes, and supporting technicians and colleagues by ensuring the right facilities, tools, and equipment are available when needed?
 

Then this could be your next career move
 

To strengthen our team in 
Antwerp, we are looking for a proactive and reliable 
Facility & Toolshop Coordinator who will take ownership of our facility operations and Toolshop management. In this independent and hands-on role, you will be responsible for maintaining a professional, safe, and efficient working environment across our office and workshop facilities. You will combine technical skills, organizational ability, and a strong sense of ownership to ensure that our employees have the right workplace and tools to perform their activities successfully.
 

This is not a traditional facility role. As Facility & Toolshop Coordinator, you will be the process owner of our Toolshop and the key contact for facility-related activities within Everllence Belgium. Your contribution directly supports our workshop teams, field service engineers, and daily operations. If you are someone who sees what needs to be done, takes initiative, and enjoys making improvements happen, we would like to hear from you. 

What makes this role unique?
 

You will have responsibility for two important operational areas: 
Facility Management and Toolshop Management.
 

You will ensure that our workplace remains safe, organized, and operational while also managing the complete lifecycle of our professional tools. From registration and availability to inspection, maintenance, and return processes, you ensure that every tool is traceable, safe, and ready for use. You will work closely with workshop technicians, field service engineers, HSE, Procurement, and external suppliers. Your role is essential in creating operational reliability and supporting our teams to deliver high-quality service to our customers.
 

Your role
Facility & Workplace Management
 
 

• Take ownership of facility operations, including office, workshop, storage areas, and workplace improvements. 

• Perform and coordinate maintenance activities, repairs, and technical improvements. 

• Ensure a safe, clean, and professional working environment. 

• Manage facility services, suppliers, and maintenance partners. 

• Support safety, compliance, logistics, and workshop organization.  

Toolshop Management
 
 

• Own and coordinate the daily Toolshop process, including tool availability, registration, and traceability. 

• Ensure tools are maintained, inspected, calibrated, and safely available for technicians. 

• Manage tool inventory, repairs, replacements, and preparation of equipment for projects. 

• Support workshop and field service teams by providing the right tools at the right time. 

Who are you?
You are a hands-on and reliable professional with a strong sense of ownership. You enjoy solving practical challenges, working independently, and creating a safe and organized working environment.
 

You bring:
 
 

• A proactive and solution-oriented mindset. 

• Strong technical understanding and practical skills. 

• A structured, accurate, and safety-focused way of working. 

• Good communication skills and a service-oriented attitude.   

Your experience & qualifications
 
 

• Technical or facility-related background with experience in an industrial environment. 

• Basic mechanical and electrical knowledge. 

• Experience with maintenance, tools, inventory, or facility processes. 

• Experience with digital systems and administration. 

• Valid driving license B. 

• VCA certification or willingness to obtain one. 

• Experience within the maritime sector, tool management, inspections, or Lean/5S is an advantage. 

• Languages: Dutch fluent and good professional English.

Optimisation of plant performance – quality, safety, cycle times, costs etc….

As Chief Project Officer, you will lead our complete project portfolio in the Benelux and across Europe. You will manage three direct reports and take responsibility for a multidisciplinary project organisation of approximately 15 employees across BIM, work preparation, project management, site management, automation and part of the validation activities. You will create the structure, standards and leadership needed to support continued growth.

You will get to know our customers, markets and ADAPTUS platform (our modular platform for standardised, scalable cleanroom solutions) inside out.

Your responsibilities include:

•Taking final responsibility for projects from design and execution through to delivery

•Leading, coaching and developing three direct reports and the wider multidisciplinary project organisation of approximately 15 employees

•Acting as a technical sparring partner on complex HVAC and cleanroom challenges

•Safeguarding margins, planning, quality and performance across the project portfolio

•Building and managing reliable subcontractor networks throughout Europe

•Driving standardisation and process optimisation through the ADAPTUS platform

•Translating our European ambitions into a scalable project organisation
 

Once you have demonstrated clear leadership, organisational impact and operational excellence, your responsibilities will expand to Chief Operating Officer.

As COO, you will take responsibility for a broader operational organisation of approximately 22 employees on the ABN payroll, complemented by an extensive network of subcontractors responsible for project execution. Your scope will include projects and service, including maintenance, validation and operational customer support. You will develop service into a profitable activity within our Cleanroom-as-a-Service strategy and connect projects and service into one seamless customer lifecycle.

The transition to Chief Operating Officer is based on demonstrated leadership, organisational impact and operational excellence. For the right candidate, this progression is expected within approximately six to eighteen months.

You combine strong leadership skills with genuine technical depth.

HVAC holds no secrets for you. You understand air handling, pressure cascades, cooling loads and control technology well enough to challenge BIM specialists, work preparation teams, project managers, site managers, automation experts, validation specialists and subcontractors on content.

You also bring:

•At least ten years of experience in complex technical projects at customer sites

•Several years of experience in a senior leadership role

•Experience managing managers and multidisciplinary technical teams, rather than only operational teams

•Proven greenfield experience in another European country

•Hands-on experience sourcing, contracting and managing local subcontractors abroad

•A technical master’s degree or equivalent experience

•Fluency in Dutch and English; French or German is an advantage

•A structural willingness to travel across Europe

•An entrepreneurial, hands-on and highly result-driven mindset
 

Experience in cleanrooms, pharmaceuticals, biotech, laboratories, food production or high-tech environments is a strong asset.

Above all, you are a builder. You do not wait for the perfect structure — you create it.

Scope

Are you an expert in elevator technology with a passion for troubleshooting? Do you enjoy working independently and managing your own service route? We are looking for an experienced Service Technician (Elevators) to join our professional team in the East and West Flanders regions.

 

As a Senior Service Technician, you are the technical face of the company. You will be responsible for the safety, reliability, and optimal performance of a diverse portfolio of lift installations.

 

Your Key Responsibilities:

• Maintenance & Inspection: Perform periodic preventive maintenance according to safety standards and regulations.
• Diagnostics & Fault-finding: Identify and resolve complex mechanical and electrical malfunctions independently.
• Repairs: Execute necessary repairs and replace worn or damaged components.
• Technical Reporting: Document your work clearly and advise clients on necessary upgrades or preventive measures.
• Safety: Ensure all work is carried out according to the strictest safety protocols.
 

• Experience: At least 5 years of experience in elevator maintenance and troubleshooting is mandatory.
• Education: A technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, or Maintenance Technology (or equivalent through experience).
• Independence: Ability to work autonomously "on the road" with a strong sense of responsibility.
• Languages: Fluent in English and/or Dutch.
• Certifications: * Valid Driver’s License B (mandatory).
• VCA certification is a major plus.
• BA5 (Competent person for electrical installations) is highly preferred.
• Soft Skills: Customer-oriented, problem-solver, and flexible mindset.
